activity_screen.rule_ar: يجب أن يكون النشاط الأساسي للشركة مباحًا؛ الشركة ذات النشاط الأساسي المحظور غير متوافقة مهما كانت نسبها المالية.
activity_screen.rule_en: The company's main activity must be permissible. A company whose main activity is prohibited (interest-based finance, alcohol, pork, gambling, adult content, etc.) is non-compliant regardless of its ratios.

basis: AAOIFI Sharia Standard 21. Musaffa (AAOIFI, certified by Amanah Advisors) and Faisal Securities Brokerage (AAOIFI, per its published criteria) apply the same three ratio limits; they differ only in the market-value denominator, which is therefore a parameter of this rule set, not a hard-coded choice.
name_ar: المعيار الشرعي رقم 21 لهيئة أيوفي — الأوراق المالية (الأسهم والسندات)، كما يطبقه مصفّى وفيصل لتداول الأوراق المالية
name_en: AAOIFI Sharia Standard No. 21 — Financial Papers (Shares and Bonds), as operationalised by Musaffa and Faisal Securities
notes: No separate liquid-assets ratio: under this operationalisation, liquidity is captured inside interest-bearing assets (Musaffa states this explicitly).
No entry/exit buffers are published by either operationalisation; buffers are reserved in the engine schema for standards that define them (e.g. MSCI Islamic, a later rule set).

denominator_variant.notes: Faisal Securities measures both interest ratios against current market cap, so its verdicts can move daily with price. Musaffa measures against the trailing 36-month average market value, smoothing price moves. Both are published AAOIFI operationalisations; the benchmark in this series compares against each source using its own variant.

avg36m.label_ar: متوسط القيمة السوقية لآخر 36 شهرًا (صيغة مصفّى)

spot.label_ar: القيمة السوقية الحالية في تاريخ الفحص (صيغة فيصل)
spot.label_en: spot market capitalisation at the screening date (Faisal Securities variant)

purification.notes_ar: التطهير واجب وفق أيوفي عن الجزء غير المتوافق من الدخل. النسبة هي حصة كل توزيع واجبة التطهير، وقيمة السهم هي الدخل غير المتوافق المنسوب لسهم واحد خلال الفترة المالية.
purification.notes_en: Purification is mandatory under AAOIFI for the non-permissible portion of income. The ratio is the share of each dividend that must be purified; the per-share figure is the non-permissible income attributable to one share over the statement period.

ratios.label_ar: الأصول والودائع ذات الفوائد / القيمة السوقية
ratios.label_en: Interest-bearing assets and deposits / market value
